g.text: Cooling a saturated solution can produce crystals while the mother liquor reaches lower solubility
Hypothetical single-solute, anhydrous-crystal model s(T)=0.20+0.005T. No solvent evaporation or solvent incorporation in crystals; mother liquor is
saturated at20°C. Total160 kg=30 crystals+130 liquor. Supersaturation and nucleation kinetics are not predicted by the equilibrium solubility curve.
